_hinweis: Szenenplan Jona, Buchebene (BRIEF-JON), im Aquarellstil nach PROC-BILD-AQUARELL@2.3, am 2026-11-21 als Beispiel für die Analyse «Visuelle Sprache der ganzen Bibel» (Andi Neck). Erzählung: alle vier Stationen als gemalte Szene. Gott wird nicht gemalt; seine Frage am Schluss steht im Band. Keine fachliche Prüfung.

figuren.FIG-JONA: Jonah: a man of about forty, short dark beard, dark hair, weather-worn face; a sea-blue robe (the only person in sea-blue), bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-SEELEUTE: Sailors: three sturdy men of different ages in short undyed work tunics with headbands, bare arms.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SCHIFF: A small wooden merchant ship of the 8th century BC with one mast.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GROSSER-FISCH: A huge grey-blue fish, simple shape, no teeth shown, not a cartoon.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: The people of Nineveh: men and women of different ages in rough dark sackcloth, dignified, never caricatured.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-KOENIG: The king of Nineveh: an older bearded man with a simple gold crown, in sackcloth, his fine mantle laid aside.
figuren.FIG-ORT-NINIVE: Nineveh: long mud-brick walls with a gate and a small stepped tower, drawn with a few lines.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-RIZINUS-VERDORRT: A withered castor-oil plant with large hand-shaped leaves hanging down dry and brown.

kenn_en.FIG-JONA: a bearded man in a sea-blue robe
kenn_en.FIG-GRUPPE-SEELEUTE: men in short work tunics with headbands

FIG-JONA.en: Is there a bearded man in a sea-blue robe?

bilder.note_de: Vier Stationen, eine je Kapitel ([[JON.1.1-JON.4.11]]): Flucht und Sturm, Rettung aus dem Fisch, Umkehr Ninives, Gottes Frage an Jona. Gott wird nicht gemalt; der Schluss bleibt offen wie im Text ([[JON.4.11]]).

JON-B1.bild_en: Ancient Mediterranean, 8th century BC. A small wooden merchant ship with one mast and a furled sail tosses on high grey-blue storm waves. Three sailors in short work tunics with headbands lift Jonah – a bearded man of about forty in a sea-blue robe – over the side of the ship towards the sea; Jonah does not resist, his face calm and resigned. The ship is in the CENTRE, the waves are a few broad loose washes. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Auf Jonas eigenes Wort heben die Seeleute ihn hoch und werfen ihn ins Meer.
Grosser Sturm, das Schiff droht zu zerbrechen.
Schiffsform, Kleidung der Seeleute: plausible Ausgestaltung.
Jonas ruhiges Gesicht steht für «auf sein eigenes Wort hin».

pruefung.en: Are men on a ship lifting or throwing a man in a sea-blue robe over the side into the sea?
Is the sea stormy, with high waves?
Is there any figure, face or hand in the sky, or any figure that looks like God?

JON-B2.bild_en: A quiet shore: on the RIGHT, a huge grey-blue fish lies half in the shallow water at the beach with its mouth open; on the LEFT, Jonah – a bearded man of about forty in a wet sea-blue robe – kneels on the dry sand, his face and both open hands lifted in thanks. Calm sea as one pale wash. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Ein grosser Fisch verschlingt Jona und speit ihn ans trockene Land.
Der Fisch speit Jona ans trockene Land aus.
Der Text sagt «grosser Fisch», nicht welche Art; gemalt ist ein grosser Fisch, kein bestimmtes Tier.
Gebet und Ausspeien sind in einem Bild zusammengezogen; im Text betet Jona im Bauch des Fisches.

pruefung.en: Is there a very large fish at the shore or in the shallow water?

pruefung.de: Jona auf dem trockenen Land, dankend
pruefung.en: Is a man in a sea-blue robe kneeling or standing on dry land with raised hands or face?
Is there any figure, face or hand in the sky, or any figure that looks like God?

JON-B3.bild_en: Inside the great city of Nineveh, 8th century BC (a few lines of mud-brick walls and a gate behind): Jonah in his sea-blue robe stands on the LEFT and calls out, one arm raised; on the RIGHT the people of Nineveh – men and women of different ages in rough dark sackcloth – kneel and sit with bowed heads, fasting; among them the king, recognisable by a simple crown, sits in ashes in sackcloth, his fine mantle lying beside him. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

speech.de: Noch vierzig Tage, und Ninive wird umgestürzt!
speech.gsw: No vierzg Täg, und Ninive wird umgstürzt!

evidence.de: Jona ruft: «Noch vierzig Tage, und Ninive wird umgestürzt!»
Die Leute glauben, fasten und ziehen Sacktuch an; der König setzt sich in die Asche.
Stadtmauer aus Lehmziegeln, Krone als Erkennungszeichen des Königs.
Im Text hört der König davon; hier steht er mit im Bild.

pruefung.en: Are several people in rough dark clothing kneeling or sitting with bowed heads?
Is a man in a sea-blue robe calling out to the people, with a raised arm?

pruefung.de: Der König in Sacktuch in der Asche
pruefung.en: Is there a man with a crown sitting on the ground in rough dark clothing?
Is there any figure, face or hand in the sky, or any figure that looks like God?

JON-B4.bild_en: East of the city: Jonah in his sea-blue robe sits alone on the ground on the LEFT under a simple shelter of branches beside a withered castor-oil plant whose large hand-shaped leaves hang down dry and brown; he props his head on his hand, sullen and exhausted in the hot sun. Far away on the RIGHT, the city of Nineveh is a pale low line of walls with a small stepped tower. Dry, empty land as one pale ochre wash. Medium-wide shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Jona sitzt östlich der Stadt in einer Hütte und wartet, was geschieht.
Der Rizinus verdorrt; die Sonne sticht Jona auf den Kopf.
Gottes Frage, ob er nicht Mitleid mit Ninive haben soll, steht im Band; Gott wird nicht gemalt.
Das Buch endet mit der offenen Frage; das Bild zeigt keine Antwort Jonas.

pruefung.en: Is a man in a sea-blue robe sitting alone outdoors?
Is there a withered plant with large drooping dry leaves next to the man?
Is a city visible far away in the background?
Does the man look sullen, angry or exhausted?
Is there any figure, face or hand in the sky, or any figure that looks like God?
